headline: Senior Certified Accountant (OCC) | Multi-Client Portfolio & Tax Compliance Specialist
summary: Results-oriented Certified Accountant with over 7 years of progressive experience in multi-client accounting consultancies in northern Portugal. Registered member of the Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (OCC) holding a Mestrado in Taxation. Proven track record of managing diverse portfolios of national and foreign-owned SMEs, ensuring full compliance with the Sistema de Normalização Contabilística (SNC) and Portuguese tax legislation. Highly skilled in Primavera ERP and PHC CS, financial statement preparation, and cross-border client advisory.

experience.title: Senior Certified Accountant
experience.employer: NorteFiscal — Sociedade de Contabilidade e Consultoria, Lda.
bullets: Act as the appointed Certified Accountant (Contabilista Certificado) for a portfolio of 38 national and international SME clients across the technology, retail, and real estate sectors, with combined annual revenues exceeding €25M.

Lead the preparation and timely submission of all statutory tax declarations, including periodic VAT (IVA), Corporate Income Tax (Modelo 22 / IRC), IES/DA, and Personal Income Tax (IRS), maintaining a 100% on-time filing record.

Produce monthly and quarterly management reporting packages and balance sheet analyses in English for 12 foreign-owned subsidiaries, presenting financial performance directly to international directors.
Spearheaded the migration of 25 client accounts from legacy systems to Primavera ERP v10, automating bank reconciliations and SAF-T (PT) imports, which reduced monthly closing times by 28%.
Supervise and review the daily bookkeeping work of 3 junior accounting technicians, conducting monthly technical training sessions on tax law updates.

experience.title: Certified Accountant
bullets: Managed end-to-end general accounting and tax compliance for 22 small and medium-sized enterprises under the Sistema de Normalização Contabilística (SNC) using PHC CS software.
Executed annual closing procedures, including tax accruals, depreciation schedules, deferred tax calculations, and preparation of annual financial statements and tax dossiers (Dossier Fiscal).
Assisted clients during 6 Autoridade Tributária (Tax Authority) audits and VAT refund inspections, successfully securing over €180,000 in VAT reimbursements with zero penalties.
Implemented standardized digital archiving workflows for supplier invoices via e-Fatura integration, cutting manual data entry errors by 35%.

experience.title: Junior Accountant
experience.employer: ContaMinho — Serviços de Gestão e Fiscalidade
bullets: Performed daily classification and posting of accounting documents, bank reconciliations, and fixed asset ledger maintenance for a portfolio of 15 local businesses.
Prepared monthly payroll processing, Social Security declarations (Declaração de Remunerações), and monthly withholding tax submissions (Retenções na Fonte IRS/IRC).
Completed the professional internship required for admission to the Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (OCC), achieving a final examination score of 16/20.
